metadata.description: Core metadata for the application, such as name and version.

ui.description: User interface configuration for the installer.

files.description: Collection of file entries to be installed.

file_associations.description: Optional list of file associations to be registered on the target system.

services.description: Optional list of services to be registered and managed.

tasks.description: Optional configuration for pre-install and post-install tasks.

features.description: Optional list of features that can be selectively installed.

output_dir.description: Directory where the built installer will be placed.

output_name.description: Base name for the output installer file.

compression.description: Compression algorithm used for the payload (e.g., 'brotli', 'gzip').

targets.description: List of target platforms to build for.

installer_target.description: Specific target platform for the installer.

stub_path.description: Path to the runtime stub executable.

tool_path.description: Optional path to signtool.exe. Defaults to resolving signtool from PATH.

certificate_path.description: Path to a certificate file, commonly a PFX, resolved after environment substitution.

certificate_thumbprint.description: Certificate SHA-1 thumbprint in the Windows certificate store.

certificate_subject.description: Certificate subject name in the Windows certificate store.

store_name.description: Certificate store name used with store-based signing, for example 'My'.

store_location.description: Certificate store location: current_user or local_machine.

certificate_password_env.description: Name of an environment variable containing the certificate password.

certificate_password.description: Plaintext passwords are not supported; use certificate_password_env.

file_digest_algorithm.description: The digest algorithm to use for the file.

timestamp_digest_algorithm.description: The digest algorithm to use for the timestamp.

codesign_path.description: Optional path to codesign. Defaults to resolving codesign from PATH.

xcrun_path.description: Optional path to xcrun. Defaults to resolving xcrun from PATH.

identity.description: Developer ID or other codesign identity.

keychain.description: Optional keychain path or name to pass to codesign.

timestamp.description: Whether to include a secure timestamp.

notarization_profile.description: Optional notarytool keychain profile. Requires a DMG package target.

staple.description: Whether to staple the notarization ticket to the application.

register_arp.description: Whether to register the application in Add/Remove Programs (Windows only).

package.description: Package type: none (raw ELF and bundle) or appimage.
Package type: none (raw Mach-O and bundle) or dmg.

logo_path.description: Path to the logo image file, relative to the payload.

assets.description: List of UI assets (e.g., license files, images).

wizard_steps.description: Sequence of steps in the installation wizard.

path.description: Path to the asset file, relative to the payload.

title.description: Title shown at the top of the wizard step.

source.description: Source content for the step (e.g., an asset ID for a license step).

default_path.description: Default path for path selection steps.

show_logs.description: Whether to show logs during the progress step. Defaults to true.

source_dir.description: Source directory for the files, relative to the project root.

include.description: List of glob patterns to include.

exclude.description: List of glob patterns to exclude.

features.description: Optional list of feature identifiers this entry belongs to. When null or empty, the matched files are always installed (core). When set, the matched files are only installed if at least one referenced feature is selected.

extension.description: The file extension, including the leading dot (e.g., '.txt').

description.description: A brief description of the file type.

prog_id.description: Optional ProgID for the file association (e.g., 'MyApp.oef.1'). If omitted, one will be generated based on the application name and extension.

icon.description: The path to the icon file for this file type, relative to the installation directory.

command.description: The command to execute when opening a file of this type. Use %1 as a placeholder for the file path.

mime_type.description: Optional MIME type for this file association (Linux only). If omitted, one will be derived from the extension.

bundle_path.description: Optional path to the .app bundle to register associations for (macOS only).

features.description: Optional list of feature identifiers that gate this association. When null or empty, the association is always registered.

require.description: Optional OS predicate that must be true for this service to be installed. Supported values: os.isWindows, os.isLinux, os.isMacOS, or os.isOSX.

name.description: Service name. On macOS this is used as the launchd Label; reverse-DNS names are recommended.

display_name.description: Optional display name for platforms that distinguish it from the service name.

scope.description: Service scope: system or user. Windows supports system only. Defaults to system.

enabled.description: Whether the service should be enabled for startup. Defaults to true.

start.description: Whether the service should be started immediately after installation. Defaults to false.

executable.description: Path to the service executable. Supports PolyInstall path placeholders.

arguments.description: Optional command-line arguments passed to the service executable.

working_directory.description: Optional working directory. Supports PolyInstall path placeholders.

restart.description: Optional restart policy. Supported values are platform-specific.

environment.description: Optional environment variables for the service.

features.description: Optional list of feature identifiers that gate this service. When null or empty, the service is always installed.

pre_install.description: Tasks that run after the user confirms the installation destination, but before any files are copied to disk.

post_install.description: Tasks that run after all files have been copied to the installation directory and the installation is complete.

pre_uninstall.description: Tasks that run at the very start of uninstallation, before files are deleted.

post_uninstall.description: Tasks that run after pre-uninstallation tasks, but still before files are deleted.

require.description: Optional OS predicate that must be true for this task to run. Supported values: os.isWindows, os.isLinux, os.isMacOS, os.isUnix, etc.

action.description: Action to perform. Supported actions: create_shortcut, write_registry, create_desktop_entry, set_permissions, add_to_path, file_association.

parameters.description: Key/value map of parameters for the chosen action.

features.description: Optional list of feature identifiers that gate this task. When null or empty, the task always runs (subject to the Require predicate).

id.description: Unique identifier for the feature. This ID is referenced by files, tasks, and file associations. Lowercase snake_case is recommended.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the installer's features step.

description.description: Short description shown alongside the feature checkbox in the installer.

default_selected.description: Whether the feature is pre-checked on a fresh install. Defaults to true.

core_files.description: Relative payload paths that are always installed regardless of selected features.

feature_files.description: Map of feature id → relative payload paths that belong to that feature. A file may appear under multiple features.
